en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large fortified castle with high stone walls, corner bastions, and a tall round tower. A road and walkway curve along the front of the fortifications, with a few pedestrians and a carriage visible. Mountains rise in the background. Printed captions and handwritten notes appear on the front, including the name of the city and castle.
